title: Password Behavior
description: x-password wraps a password <input> with a show/hide button, and with strength adds a meter that rates the password as it is typed.

toggle.description: Show/hide button beside the field. On unless toggle="false".

strength.description: Strength meter under the field, scored 0-4 as the password is typed (length 8+, mixed case, a digit, a symbol).

wbBehavior.name: password
wbBehavior.description: Adds show/hide toggle and strength meter to password fields.

$view.name: input
$view.description: The host <input type="password"> itself, moved into a .x-password wrapper and given x-password__input. Gets autocomplete="new-password" or "current-password" from its name/id when the author set none.

$view.name: toggle
$view.description: Switches the field between type=password and type=text; its title reads Show password / Hide password.

$view.name: strength-bar
$view.description: The meter's fill: x-password__strength-bar--s0 to --s4 sets its width and colour from the score.
